notes.title: Card Buster Playtest 3 UPDATE
notes.content:
We just updated the playtest with plenty of improvements and you still have a few days to play Card Buster and provide some feedback at our Discord server: https://discord.gg/8sqVp75R

What's new?[olist]
Deckbuild and Card Upgrade screens are now just one menu!

Talk to the card upgrade NPC, right click on a card to upgrade it or left click to add to your deck.

You can now upgrade cards in your deck by directly right clicking on them in the deckbuild list view.

Tooltips for cards added. Hover over a card and wait to see more details of a card. 

Buster now runs in 360 degrees as she should with the controller! 

Dash cooldown is lowered. 

Card Trader offers are now WAY BETTER. 

Some UI bugs fixed. 

Some gameplay bugs fixed. 
[/olist]


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42469133/8a9e9512041b724f7ee4dc204d136b71e81dee90.gif"]

notes.title: Card Buster Playtest 2 UPDATE
notes.content:
This update is a big one because it is not only a hotfix, but we are also ADDING A NEW WEAPON CARD TO CARD BUSTER!

New card: BASEBALL BAT
Smash enemies in front of you with mighty baseball bat strikes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42469133/1ceed260efc020d1ebda41da80748ea6254f008d.gif

Also we fixed plenty of bugs/issues on this update too! Here are some of them:
Fixed the weird bug that caused game to slow down after a few restarts.
Fixed a bug that caused collected Can Tabs to not be added to your total after a run is completed.
Fixed a bug that caused Tank Mushrooms' rock throw attacks to not hit the player. Game is a bit harder now!
Fixed a bug that caused player to have no health at the tutorial. You shouldn't fall in one hit now!
Card upgrades now work!
Spears thrown at you now are blocked by environmental obstacles!
Player aim should be more accurate now.
Player rotation is no longer broken when aiming off the maps.
Player health can't go under 0 now.
Updated maps so that it is harder to fall down trying to get on the drones.
Added collision to some maps that lacked them. (looking at you rocky zones)

Thank you everybody for reporting bugs. This playtest is going great for us and your feedback helps Card Buster immensely!

Please go ahead and try out our new card "Baseball Bat" and enjoy amazing new combos!

Give your feedback over on our Discord: https://discord.gg/F6GSCa3Z

notes.title: Card Buster Online Playtest 2 Hotfix
notes.content:
After a few days of testing and reported issues we got to work, fixed some problems, and updated some visual stuff for this update!

Here are some of the fixed issues:
1. Fixed a bug causing the game to be locked when settings menu in the main menu is opened.
2. Fixed a bug causing the game to be locked when players reach the last stage.
3. Fixed a bug that caused tearing to shadows on the top side of the screen.
4. Added a low hp screen effect.
5. Changed reward pickup texts to show button images instead of text to interact.
6. Removed dash input delay and dash input stacking.
7. Lowered "Haymaker" weapon attack cooldown.
8. Added fencing in some scenes in which it was very annoying to fall down.
9. Made some performance improvements.

Thank you everybody for reporting bugs. Hopefully the gameplay should be smoother now! 

Join our Discord server to join the conversation and give feedback: https://discord.gg/9PBu8Ppv

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42469133/5f865aef8ba3222ec18fa8c1a6a2eb7595b451c1.png

notes.title: First Online Card Buster Playtest Ended!
notes.content:
A BIG THANK YOU TO OUR COMMUNITY FOR TRYING OUT THE GAME AND PROVIDING AMAZING FEEDBACK!

We released an online playtest for Card Buster on November 8th, left it running for the past three weeks, and shut down the Playtest today. It was amazing and thank you all who tried the game out and provided us with gameplay feedback/bug reports!

Getting fresh feedback from new people is extremely important. It only helps improve the game and grow the community. We are determined to organize online playtests in the future, so stay tuned!

Join our Discord server while you are here: https://discord.gg/FM3C5etb
